Mobilis SA, filiale d’Algérie Télécom, l: Mobilis SA, a subsidiary of Algérie Télécom, is launching two new mobile internet packs, MobiNet and MobiNet Plus, designed to meet the growing connectivity needs of Algerians. With plans including up to 300 GB of data and extended durations, these offers aim to reduce the digital divide in the country.
Mobilis SA, opérateur historique algérie: Mobilis SA, the historic Algerian operator, announces the launch of two innovative mobile internet packs: MobiNet (9,000 DZD) and MobiNet Plus (16,000 DZD). These offers include a mobile Wi-Fi modem and a dedicated SIM card, ensuring uninterrupted high-speed connectivity. The first pack offers 200 GB valid for 9 months, shareable among 16 users, while MobiNet Plus offers 300 GB for 12 months, with sharing possible among 32 users. Once the volume is consumed, the speed remains unlimited (though reduced). Users can also activate 30 GB boosts for an additional 500 DZD, providing flexibility tailored to occasional needs.
« Ces forfaits visent à faciliter l’accè: "These plans aim to facilitate access to high-speed connectivity for everyone, everywhere in Algeria."
Ces offres s’inscrivent dans une stratég: These offers are part of a global strategy to reduce the digital divide in Algeria, where internet access remains a key issue for economic and social development. With a mobile penetration rate exceeding 120% in 2025 and over 30 million internet subscribers, Mobilis plays a central role in the democratization of digital technologies. The MobiNet and MobiNet Plus packs specifically target rural areas and sparsely populated wilayas, where fixed infrastructure is limited. Economically, these plans stimulate the consumption of digital services, promoting teleworking, e-commerce, and cloud solutions. For businesses, particularly startups and SMEs, these packs reduce connectivity costs while offering stable bandwidth.
Mobilis prévoit une campagne de sensibil: Mobilis is planning an awareness campaign across the 48 wilayas where it operates, to promote these packs to individuals and professionals. Customers will be able to subscribe via agencies, online platforms, or authorized retailers. Soon, a dedicated mobile application will be launched to simplify plan management and boost activation. In the long term, Mobilis plans to extend these offers to professional solutions, in collaboration with Algérie Télécom, aligned with the objectives of the 2030 digital plan, which targets a 30% increase in mobile data consumption by 2027. The next steps also include the accelerated deployment of 5G in major cities and strategic economic zones.
Avec le lancement de MobiNet et MobiNet: With the launch of MobiNet and MobiNet Plus, Mobilis is strengthening its leadership in the Algerian telecoms sector, while aligning with the ambitions of the 2030 digital plan for a connected and innovative Algeria.
